description: Generate or update the portal's AI landing page. An asynchronous operation — check the status through check_ai_site_status. For a redesign pass existing_html from get_portal_page.

existing_html.description: The current HTML for a redesign (from get_portal_page). If empty, the site is generated from scratch.

prompt.description: Description of the site or the redesign instruction. For example: 'A modern clinic website with a booking form'

name: generate_ai_site
